ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-grey interior comprising approximately 85% of visible surface area, contrasted with a low-intensity black peripheral band on the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous large-scale white central zone; irregular black peripheral banding with fine-scale pigment intrusions (mottling) at the transition zones; yellowish-tan high-contrast clusters located at the terminal coordinates of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees and a depth of roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke visibility.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from 15 to 35 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve originating from the median notch, extending laterally and tapering toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of irregular yellowish-brown pixel clusters at the lateral fluke tips, corresponding to barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular V-shaped notch/truncation on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive barnacle encrustations at the terminal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct deep indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe, located approximately two-thirds of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
